description: List the categories Ptitchef browses its recipes by. Called without arguments it returns the families of ingredients; pass a family's slug as 'family' to list the categories it holds. Read this before building an address by hand: the site writes its slugs freely, so the same vegetable appears as 'chou-kale' on one line and as 'recette-de-petits-pois' on the next, and a slug that was guessed lands on a page the site does not hold. Each entry carries the slug to pass back and the page to open.

family.description: The slug of a family to open, taken from a previous call. Leave it out to read the families themselves, which is where the tree starts.

limit.description: Entries to render, 20 by default and 200 at most. A level holding more than this says so, and 'categories_published' always states what the page listed.

name: list_categories

description.description: The site's own blurb. Null when the page carries none for this entry.

is_family.description: True when this entry opens onto further categories rather than onto recipes.

sample_children.description: Entries the site shows beside this one. It is an excerpt the site marks as such, so it states nothing about how many the entry holds.

slug.description: Pass this back as 'family', or use it to browse the recipes under it.

title.description: The site's own wording for it.

url.description: The public page. Show this when citing the category.

slug.description: Pass this back as 'family', or use it to browse the recipes under it.

title.description: The site's own wording for it.

url.description: The public page. Show this when citing the category.

categories_published.description: Entries the page listed, before any were rendered.

family.description: The family that was opened, or null for the root.

family_title.description: The site's own heading for this level. Null when the page carries none.

url.description: The page these categories were read from.

title: List the categories recipes are browsed by
